rules.failure_means: the partial products do not swing as the public Booth generator says, or something keeps them from reaching the tree on a zero operand
rules.what: the recoder is on A: a live zero costs more when it sits on B (partial products all-0 / all-1) than on A (every digit zero), though B moves twice as often

rules.failure_means: filling pairs saves nothing against one zero word in each pair: no eight-byte rule at this resolution
rules.what: int8's eight-byte B rule: the same eight zero words a line cost less when they fill (l, l+8) pairs

rules.failure_means: the RTL's pairing does not hold on silicon; if b_pairs_alt reads below b_pairs_rtl by more than the margin, A4's reading holds and every int8 gate figure on the page changes (kinds.json's gated_lane_frac_alt_grouping replaces gated_lane_frac)
rules.what: int8's column pairing: zero words filling (l, l+8) cost less than the same words filling (2l, 2l+1)

rules.failure_means: the (2l, 2l+1) arrangement differs from unpaired: a pairing the two readings do not describe, or a lane-position effect
rules.what: the control: (2l, 2l+1) pairs gate nothing, so they cost what unpaired zero words cost

rules.failure_means: a word with one nonzero byte is gated, or costs next to nothing live: the A test is not the whole word
rules.what: int8's A rule: three of four bytes zero leaves the lane on; four of four gates it

rules.failure_means: the zeros' sign does not matter: lanes on a -0 operand cost no more than gated ones in this mix
rules.what: the same sparse numbers cost more when half their zeros are -0.0, as x * mask leaves them

fp16.a_dnr_b_randn.reference: as fp16.a_nz_b_randn, with A's raw denormal bits added at E88's a; flushed, so no partial product moves
fp16.a_dnr_b_randn.rule: A = dnr_both's A; B = E78 a_zeros_b_randn's B, byte for byte

fp16.a_nz_b_randn.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the B bits at E88's a; A = -0 holds every Booth digit at zero, so no partial product moves; high arm adds E88's frozen sign cost, the product's sign flips as often as in s_abs
fp16.a_nz_b_randn.rule: A all (-0.0, -0.0); B = E78 a_zeros_b_randn's B, byte for byte

fp16.a_randn_b_nz.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the A bits at E88's a, plus the partial products: a negative Booth digit on multiplicand zero gives all ones (txfma_booth_ppg_32r4_norm.v), priced per bit from E88's M; high arm adds half the sign cost (A's sign changes every second micro-op)
fp16.a_randn_b_nz.rule: A = E78 a_randn_b_zeros's A, byte for byte; B all (-0.0, -0.0)

fp16.dnr_both.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the raw denormal bits at E88's a: txfma_f0.v:375-377 clears the fraction, PRM 3.4 says input denormals become zero, so no partial product moves
fp16.dnr_both.rule: random fp16 denormal pairs on both sides: sign 0, exponent 0, mantissas uniform on 1..2^10-1

fp16.nz_both.reference: live share 1 x a constant's cost, nothing moves and the result stays +0: E88 fp16.c_cancel (E82 neg_ones 8.08, ones 8.06), +-1.0 W (E88 H1's bound)

fp32.a_dnr_b_randn.reference: as fp32.a_nz_b_randn, with A's raw denormal bits added at E88's a; flushed, so no partial product moves
fp32.a_dnr_b_randn.rule: A = dnr_both's A; B = E78 a_zeros_b_randn's B, byte for byte

fp32.a_nz_b_randn.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the B bits at E88's a; A = -0 holds every Booth digit at zero, so no partial product moves; high arm adds E88's frozen sign cost, the product's sign flips as often as in s_abs
fp32.a_nz_b_randn.rule: A all -0.0; B = E78 a_zeros_b_randn's B, byte for byte

fp32.a_randn_b_dnr.reference: as fp32.a_randn_b_nz with B's raw denormal bits added at E88's a: flushed, so the multiplicand is zero
fp32.a_randn_b_dnr.rule: A = E78 a_randn_b_zeros's A, byte for byte; B = dnr_both's B

fp32.a_randn_b_nz.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the A bits at E88's a, plus the partial products: a negative Booth digit on multiplicand zero gives all ones (txfma_booth_ppg_32r4_norm.v), priced per bit from E88's M; high arm adds half the sign cost (A's sign changes every second micro-op)
fp32.a_randn_b_nz.rule: A = E78 a_randn_b_zeros's A, byte for byte; B all -0.0

fp32.dn1_both.reference: live share 1 x a constant's cost: E88 fp32.c_abs, +-1.0 W; 0x00000001 is raw nonzero and flushed inside
fp32.dn1_both.rule: every word 0x00000001, the smallest denormal, on both sides

fp32.dnr_both.reference: live share 1 x the constant, plus the raw denormal bits at E88's a: txfma_f0.v:375-377 clears the fraction, PRM 3.4 says input denormals become zero, so no partial product moves
fp32.dnr_both.rule: random denormals on both sides: sign 0, exponent 0, mantissa uniform on 1..2^23-1

fp32.nz_both.reference: live share 1 x a constant's cost, nothing moves and the result stays +0: E88 fp32.c_abs (E82 neg_ones 7.98, ones 7.92, pi 8.21), +-1.0 W (E88 H1's bound)

fp32.sparse50_mask.reference: E82 fp32.sparse50 (6.76 W) plus F x the lanes -0 keeps live, plus the extra bus and partial-product bits at the same prices; the result path of the lanes that compute is unchanged
fp32.sparse50_mask.rule: E78 sparse50 with each zero word given the sign of a symmetric value it replaced, as x * mask does: half stay +0.0, half become -0.0; every other word unchanged

int8.a_3of4_b_full.reference: live share 1: low arm E88's clocked lane + a quarter of its operand-side multiplier (one byte in four), high arm E82 int8.full; under a byte-wide A rule the tile would read like E82 int8.a_zeros_b_full (0.34 W)
int8.a_3of4_b_full.rule: A: one nonzero byte in every word at a random position, the other three zero; B = E78 a_zeros_b_full's B, byte for byte

int8.b_pairs_alt.reference: under the RTL's reading every unit is live: 8 of 16 carry E82 int8.full's cost, 8 multiply A by a zero B word; low arm: those cost the clocked lane plus A's bits at E88's a (2.43 W for all 16), high arm: as much as random data, if the synthesized multiplier's recoding toggles on A with a zero multiplicand
int8.b_pairs_alt.rule: A no zero byte; B eight zero words a line, columns [0, 1, 4, 5, 10, 11, 14, 15] on even lines and the complement on odd lines; the other eight words the same in all three tiles

int8.b_pairs_rtl.reference: live share 0.5 x E82 int8.full (6.87 W) + 0.5 x E82's fully gated tiles (0.35 W), under the RTL's reading; under A4's it would read as int8.b_pairs_alt reads here
int8.b_pairs_rtl.rule: A no zero byte; B eight zero words a line, columns [0, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14] on even lines and the complement on odd lines; the other eight words the same in all three tiles

int8.b_unpaired.reference: under the RTL's reading every unit is live: 8 of 16 carry E82 int8.full's cost, 8 multiply A by a zero B word; low arm: those cost the clocked lane plus A's bits at E88's a (2.43 W for all 16), high arm: as much as random data, if the synthesized multiplier's recoding toggles on A with a zero multiplicand
int8.b_unpaired.rule: A no zero byte; B eight zero words a line, columns [0, 2, 4, 6, 9, 11, 13, 15] on even lines and the complement on odd lines; the other eight words the same in all three tiles
